title: Violencia y poder
goal: Read about the mechanisms behind the conquest beyond swords and horses: the Requerimiento, Montesinos's sermon, the 1550 debate at Valladolid, and how fast indigenous armies adapted.

items: Describe how Montesinos denounced the servitude of the indigenous in 1511 and what the 1550 Valladolid debate was about.
Explain what the Requerimiento was and how it was actually used.
Explain why some historians think Spanish military superiority is exaggerated.
Describe what power in the conquest actually depended on.
Use 'puesto que / ya que', 'en cuanto a' and 'por consiguiente' in formal historical argument.
